subject: DI02005011

body.en:
Definition

Solubility is the equilibrium amount of a specified solute that dissolves in a specified solvent at stated temperature and, where relevant, pressure.

Explanation and use

  • Always state basis:for S g solute/100g solvent, a saturated solution contains S g solute plus100g solvent, not100g total solution.
  • Solute mass fraction x=S/(100+S); solute needed for solvent W is WS/100.These relations assume no reaction or hydrate correction.
  • Unsaturated solution is below equilibrium solubility; saturated is at equilibrium; supersaturated has a higher dissolved concentration and is metastable.
  • Cooling may reduce solubility and produce crystals, but actual data must be consulted; solubility does not universally rise with temperature.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Stated temperature તથા લાગુ પડે ત્યારે pressureએ specified solventમાં equilibriumમાં દ્રવી શકે તેટલા specified soluteનું પ્રમાણ એટલે solubility.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • S g solute/100g solvent basisમાં saturated solutionમાં S g solute+100g solvent હોય, કુલ100g solution નહીં.
  • Solute mass fraction x=S/(100+S); solvent W માટે solute WS/100.No reaction/hydrate correction માનો.
  • Unsaturated equilibrium solubilityથી નીચે, saturated equilibrium પર, supersaturated વધુ dissolved concentrationવાળી metastable સ્થિતિ.
  • Coolingથી solubility ઘટી crystals મળી શકે, પણ actual data લો; દરેક soluteની solubility temperature સાથે વધે જ એવું નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Flow rate is amount crossing a section per time; density is mass per volume; mean velocity is volumetric flow per flow area.

Explanation and use

  • Mass flow ṁ in kg/s, volumetric flow Q in m³/s, molar flow ṅ in mol/s or kmol/h.Density ρ=m/V in kg/m³.
  • For a uniform-density section, ṁ=ρQ and mean velocity u=Q/A; for a circular pipe A=πD²/4.Use internal diameter.
  • Steady single-inlet/outlet flow without accumulation gives ρ1Q1=ρ2Q2.Mass rate is conserved even when gas volume flow changes with pressure/temperature.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Section પાર કરતું amount/time flow rate, mass/volume density અને volumetric flow/area mean velocity છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Mass flow ṁ kg/s, volumetric Q m³/s, molar ṅ mol/s/kmol/h; ρ=m/V kg/m³.
  • Uniform density sectionમાં ṁ=ρQ, u=Q/A; pipe A=πD²/4.Internal diameter લો.
  • Steady single-inlet/outlet/no accumulationમાં ρ1Q1=ρ2Q2.Gas Q pressure/temperatureથી બદલાય છતાં mass rate conserved રહે.

body.en:
Definition

Dynamic or absolute viscosity μ measures resistance to shear deformation; kinematic viscosity ν is dynamic viscosity divided by density.

Explanation and use

  • For a Newtonian fluid, τ=μdu/dy.μ has Pa·s=kg/(m·s), dimension ML⁻¹T⁻¹; it is not a pressure by itself.
  • ν=μ/ρ in m²/s, dimension L²T⁻¹.1P=0.1Pa·s; 1cP=0.001Pa·s; 1St=10⁻⁴m²/s; 1cSt=10⁻⁶m²/s.
  • State temperature because viscosity changes with temperature.Non-Newtonian fluids do not have a single shear-independent μ.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Dynamic/absolute viscosity μ shear deformationનો resistance બતાવે; kinematic ν=μ/ρ છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Newtonian fluidમાં τ=μdu/dy.μનો unit Pa·s=kg/(m·s), dimension ML⁻¹T⁻¹; માત્ર pressure નથી.
  • ν=μ/ρ, m²/s, L²T⁻¹.1P=0.1Pa·s; 1cP=0.001Pa·s; 1St=10⁻⁴m²/s; 1cSt=10⁻⁶m²/s.
  • Temperature લખો કારણ કે viscosity બદલાય છે.Non-Newtonian fluidનું μ shear-independent એક value નહીં હોય.

body.en:
Definition

Vacuum pressure indicates how far pressure lies below local atmospheric pressure; absolute pressure is referenced to perfect vacuum.

Explanation and use

  • Pabs=Patm+Pgauge with signed gauge reading.If a positive vacuum magnitude Pv is quoted, Pabs=Patm−Pv.
  • All pressure terms must share units; local Patm is not automatically1atm.Absolute pressure cannot be negative in ordinary process calculations.
  • A vacuum of60kPa does not mean Pabs=60kPa; the atmospheric reference must be supplied.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Local atmospheric pressureથી કેટલું ઓછું pressure છે તે vacuum reading; perfect vacuumથી referenced pressure absolute છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Signed gauge readingમાં Pabs=Patm+Pgauge.Positive vacuum magnitude Pv હોય તો Pabs=Patm−Pv.
  • બધા pressuresના units સમાન રાખો; local Patm આપમેળે1atm નહીં.Absolute pressure negative ન હોઈ શકે.
  • 60kPa vacuum એટલે Pabs=60kPa નહીં; atmospheric reference જોઈએ.

body.en:
Definition

Kinetic energy is energy associated with motion; gravitational potential energy is energy associated with elevation relative to a chosen datum.

Explanation and use

  • KE=mu²/2 and PE=mgz in joules; specific energies are u²/2 and gz in J/kg.
  • Potential-energy changes use ΔPE=mg(z2−z1); a negative change means a fall relative to the datum.Use consistent velocity/elevation units.
  • For a steady stream, the corresponding energy rates are ṁu²/2 and ṁgz in watts.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Motionને લીધે energy kinetic અને chosen datumથી elevationને લીધે energy gravitational potential છે.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • KE=mu²/2, PE=mgz joulesમાં; specific values u²/2, gz J/kgમાં.
  • ΔPE=mg(z2−z1); negative change એટલે datum મુજબ નીચે ઉતરવું.Velocity/elevation units consistent રાખો.
  • Steady streamના energy rates ṁu²/2, ṁgz wattsમાં હોય છે.

title.en: Vapour pressure,Perry lookup and Antoine equation

h.en: Vapour pressure,Perry lookup and Antoine equation

body.en:
Definition

Saturation vapour pressure is the equilibrium pressure of a pure vapour above its liquid at a stated temperature.

Explanation and use

  • At the normal boiling point, Psat equals standard atmospheric pressure; boiling temperature changes when external pressure changes.Psat is not the partial pressure of every component in an arbitrary mixture.
  • Perry procedure:identify compound and purity, edition/table, temperature basis, pressure unit, correlation form and valid range.Read the value or matching constants; record the actual page/table consulted.Do not invent a handbook reading.
  • Antoine form log10Psat=A−B/(T+C), so Psat=10^[A−B/(T+C)].A, B, C depend on pressure unit, temperature unit and fitted range.
  • Inverse:T=B/(A−log10Psat)−C.Use only a compatible positive absolute saturation pressure within the fit range.Do not mix Celsius constants with Kelvin input or ln with log10.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Stated temperatureએ પોતાના liquid ઉપર pure vapourનું equilibrium pressure એટલે saturation vapour pressure.

સમજણ તથા ઉપયોગ

  • Normal boiling pointએ Psat=standard atmospheric pressure; external pressure બદલાય તો boiling T બદલાય.Psat arbitrary mixtureના દરેક componentનું partial pressure નથી.
  • Perryમાં compound/purity, edition-table, T basis, P unit, correlation form/range ઓળખો.Value/મેળ ખાતા constants લો; actual consulted page/table લખો.Handbook reading બનાવશો નહીં.
  • Antoine log10Psat=A−B/(T+C), તેથી Psat=10^[A−B/(T+C)].A, B, C pressure/temperature units તથા fitted range પર આધારિત છે.
  • Inverse:T=B/(A−log10Psat)−C.Fit rangeમાં compatible positive absolute Psat લો.Celsius constantsમાં Kelvin કે log10ની જગ્યાએ ln ન મૂકો.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

S=25g solute/100g water at stated T; water=80kg.

To find

Find dissolved solute, saturated-solution mass and mass%.

Formula / necessary assumptions

ms=WS/100; x=S/(100+S).

Calculation

  1. ms=80×25/100=20kg.
  2. msolution=80+20=100kg.
  3. x=25/125=0.20; mass%=20%.

Final answer

Solute=20kg; solution=100kg; 20%w/w.

Check

25g/100g solvent is20g/100g solution, not25%w/w.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

Stated Tએ S=25g solute/100g water; water=80kg.

શું શોધવું

Solute, saturated-solution mass તથા mass% શોધો.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

ms=WS/100; x=S/(100+S).

ગણતરી

  1. ms=80×25/100=20kg.
  2. msolution=80+20=100kg.
  3. x=25/125=0.20; mass%=20%.

અંતિમ જવાબ

Solute=20kg; solution=100kg; 20%w/w.

ચકાસણી

25g/100g solvent એટલે20g/100g solution; 25%w/w નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Q=3.6m³/h; ρ=800kg/m³; internal D=0.050m.

To find

Find Q in SI, mass rate and mean velocity.

Formula / necessary assumptions

ṁ=ρQ; A=πD²/4; u=Q/A.

Calculation

  1. Q=3.6/3600=0.001m³/s.
  2. ṁ=800×0.001=0.8kg/s=2880kg/h.
  3. A=π×0.05²/4=0.00196350m².
  4. u=0.001/0.00196350=0.50930m/s.

Final answer

ṁ=0.8kg/s; u≈0.5093m/s.

Check

Q/A has m/s units; use internal diameter and squared diameter.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

μ=2cP; ρ=800kg/m³.

To find

Find ν in m²/s and cSt.

Formula / necessary assumptions

ν=μ/ρ; 1cP=0.001Pa·s; 1cSt=10⁻⁶m²/s.

Calculation

  1. μ=2×0.001=0.002Pa·s.
  2. ν=0.002/800=2.5×10⁻⁶m²/s.
  3. ν=2.5cSt.

Final answer

ν=2.5×10⁻⁶m²/s=2.5cSt.

Check

Dynamic and kinematic viscosity have different dimensions.

શું શોધવું

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

ν=μ/ρ; 1cP=0.001Pa·s; 1cSt=10⁻⁶m²/s.

ગણતરી

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Patm=100kPa; vacuum magnitude=60kPa.

To find

Find absolute and signed gauge pressure.

Formula / necessary assumptions

Pabs=Patm−Pv; Pgauge=−Pv.

Calculation

  1. Pabs=100−60=40kPa.
  2. Pgauge=40−100=−60kPa.

Final answer

Pabs=40kPa; Pgauge=−60kPa.

Check

Absolute pressure remains positive; use40kPa, not−60kPa, in a gas law.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

m=10kg; u=4m/s; z=5m; g=9.81m/s².

To find

Find KE, PE and their sum relative to the chosen datum.

Formula / necessary assumptions

KE=mu²/2; PE=mgz.

Calculation

  1. KE=10×4²/2=80J.
  2. PE=10×9.81×5=490.5J.
  3. KE+PE=570.5J.

Final answer

KE=80J; PE=490.5J; total=570.5J.

Check

The PE value depends on the stated datum; its change does not depend on an arbitrary common offset.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

ગણતરી

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Hypothetical teaching fit only:A=8, B=1500, C=200; log10P with P in kPa, T in°C; assumed valid20–80°C.T=50°C.

To find

Find P and recover T from P; these are not actual compound data.

Formula / necessary assumptions

log10P=A−B/(T+C); T=B/(A−log10P)−C.

Calculation

  1. log10P=8−1500/(50+200)=8−6=2.
  2. P=10²=100kPa.
  3. T=1500/(8−2)−200=50°C.

Final answer

P=100kPa; inverse T=50°C for this illustrative fit.

Check

Input units and range match; no value is claimed as a Perry handbook reading.
body.gu:
સમજ માટે ઉકેલેલો દાખલો;પ્રયોગની readings નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

માત્ર hypothetical teaching fit:A=8, B=1500, C=200; P kPa, T°Cમાં log10P; assumed range20–80°C.T=50°C.

શું શોધવું

P શોધી તેનાથી T પાછું મેળવો; આ actual compound data નથી.

સૂત્ર / જરૂરી ધારણાઓ

log10P=A−B/(T+C); T=B/(A−log10P)−C.

ગણતરી

  1. log10P=8−1500/(50+200)=8−6=2.
  2. P=10²=100kPa.
  3. T=1500/(8−2)−200=50°C.

અંતિમ જવાબ

P=100kPa; inverse T=50°C for this illustrative fit.

ચકાસણી

Input units/range મળે છે; Perry handbook reading હોવાનો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
Illustrative solved numerical;not laboratory readings.

Given data

Sample mass=410g; volume=500mL; ṁ=1.64kg/s.

To find

Find density and volume flow at the same state.

Formula / necessary assumptions

ρ=m/V; Q=ṁ/ρ.

Calculation

  1. m=0.410kg; V=500×10⁻⁶=0.000500m³.
  2. ρ=0.410/0.000500=820kg/m³.
  3. Q=1.64/820=0.002m³/s=7.2m³/h.

Final answer

ρ=820kg/m³; Q=0.002m³/s=7.2m³/h.

Check

The measured sample state must represent the stream state.
